entries.title: Root Maze and Nutrient Flow
entries.description: A 3D soil block with branching transparent roots that grow and turn toward glowing nutrient particles diffusing through pores, with nutrients attaching to roots, changing their color, and a side meter tracking total absorbed nutrients.
entries.seed: Root Maze and Nutrient Flow: A 3D soil block with branching transparent roots that grow and turn toward glowing nutrient particles diffusing through pores, with nutrients attaching to roots, changing their color, and a side meter tracking total absorbed nutrients.

entries.title: Earthworm Tunnels and Soil Mixing
entries.description: A light-brown semi-transparent soil cube where animated earthworm cylinders burrow, leaving tunnels behind, pushing soil particles aside, mixing dark organic particles upward and lighter mineral grains downward with trails and labels.
entries.seed: Earthworm Tunnels and Soil Mixing: A light-brown semi-transparent soil cube where animated earthworm cylinders burrow, leaving tunnels behind, pushing soil particles aside, mixing dark organic particles upward and lighter mineral grains downward with trails and labels.

entries.title: Water Infiltration and Pore Filling
entries.description: A layered soil column where blue water droplets fall from above, spread into pores, merge into thin films along grain surfaces, and slowly percolate downward, while a dynamic water table plane rises and falls with color-coded saturation levels.
entries.seed: Water Infiltration and Pore Filling: A layered soil column where blue water droplets fall from above, spread into pores, merge into thin films along grain surfaces, and slowly percolate downward, while a dynamic water table plane rises and falls with color-coded saturation levels.

entries.title: Soil Compaction Under Moving Load
entries.description: A rolling wheel or foot-shaped object moves back and forth over a soil surface, compressing a grid of soil “voxels” that shrink and darken where pressure is high, with vertical arrows showing reduced pore space and bouncing test particles showing lower infiltration.

entries.title: Microbe Colonies on Soil Aggregates
entries.description: Large spherical soil aggregates float in a 3D box while tiny colored microbial dots attach, replicate, and form glowing colonies on surfaces, sending faint pulsing connections (thin lines) that show nutrient transfer between aggregates.

entries.title: Soil Carbon Cycling with Organic Litter
entries.description: Leaf fragments on the surface slowly shrink as brown carbon particles detach, sink into soil, attach to aggregates, and then are released as rising transparent gas bubbles that collect under a “atmosphere” plane, with a carbon stock bar updating over time.

entries.title: Root Exudates and Microbial Hotspots
entries.description: Roots extend through soil and periodically emit small glowing exudate clouds that spread, fade, and attract bacteria particles, which swarm, collide, and cluster into bright hotspots, while labels show changing “activity” above each root zone.

entries.title: Soil Erosion by Surface Runoff
entries.description: A slightly sloped soil surface made of colored grains is hit by falling raindrop spheres that splash, detach grains, and push them downslope in moving rivulets, with sediment-laden water turning more opaque and depositing grains in a lower basin.

entries.title: Nutrient Diffusion from Granular Fertilizer

entries.description: Ant-like agents move through the upper soil, excavating tunnels and chambers that remain as voids, carrying soil pellets that they drop at a mound on the surface, with an overhead camera that can rotate and reveal the growing 3D nest structure.
